definitions.short: short (whether in size, number, life, strength or temper)
definitions.full: H7116. qatser [ קָצֵר ] adjective short ; — in phrase קִצְרֵייָֿד 2Kin 19:26 short of hand , feeble, = Isa 37:27 ; figurative אַמַּיִם קְצַרֿ Prov 14:7 = impatient , so רוּחַ קְצַּר 14:29 (opposed to אַמַּיִם אֶרֶח ); of time יָמִים קְצַר Job 14:1 short-lived.
